limits: Authored existing-product CSS reconstruction, not historical screenshots, full earlier-client execution or ordinary/guided AI causal experiment.
Current metadata DOM, game JavaScript, canvas ink and current shared header are intentionally identical in both arms; their earlier changes need separate original before/public receipts.
Actual naturally ended round is reached with normal keyboard/pointer actions before comparison; no injected score, forced end, model freeze or RAF override.
Both arms use ordinary reduced-motion preference. This is not a measured frame-rate or school-concurrency experiment.
Equal neutral masks hide ad areas, record/comment/room lists, not gameplay or result controls. No traffic was blocked; ordinary analytics/provider and run/start POSTs occurred.

No raw identities, private Site images, room codes, tokens, font binaries or production scripts are redistributed. Existing earlier weak/random-state captures remain retained, not promoted to exact-state proof.
Physical devices, signed-in persistence, full campaigns/modes, comprehensive accessibility, external visual approval and user design approval remain outside this evidence.
No production redeployment/restart/reset/purge, homepage commit or research PR automatic merge was performed.
